additional_info.subject: Case-translation
additional_info.body:
For the Intratuin project, there is a DC charger from Siemens. From the EMS system, this charger is completely released in terms of power. Now I see on the app of Vattenfall, among others, that 1 gun indicates 250 KW and the other only 50 kW. In my opinion, both guns should be able to deliver the same amount of power. Of course, this does not work well and scares people off. Only the EMS system will downgrade the system if there is not enough power available. This will rarely happen.
Is this a software issue from Siemens?
